# Obsidian Notes Creator Skill for Muse

Create, improve, or audit Obsidian study notes from lectures, PDFs, textbooks, or your existing notes — for a single note or a whole subject folder. It adapts depth to the learner, preserves your vault's organization when improving notes (filenames, folders, links, dates), renders math in LaTeX with ASCII, Mermaid, or SVG diagrams plus callouts, and ships with reference guides (structure, intuition-first writing, analogies, worked examples, diagrams, wikilinks) and a verification workflow with a quality checklist — honestly reporting what was actually reviewed versus merely rendered. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: student-oriented, and at its best inside an Obsidian vault; the output quality depends on the verification step actually being run. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
